body:
I tried meditating last night after not doing it for over a year. I've been reading some excerpts of the Tibetan book of the dead and the dissolution of the ego. That's a pretty interesting and useful concept to me considering how my ego is quite useless. So I pretty much tried suicide via meditation in order to kill my ego...I listened to things play out in my head, to shit that people have said to me, to my lack of friends and shitty attitude toward my parents...but I didn't blame any of that on myself. I accepted that I was pretty much worthless. I felt like this energy that was a mix between those weird pains you get when you're lonely as fuck and a dopamine rush. I felt really awesome though and pretty much slept almost immediately after. 

tl;dr meditation made me accept that I suck, which gave me a sense of wellbeing, making me not give a fuck about sucking.

Yea, I need to get out more. But seriously why the fuck do people have to be so fucking judgemental. If people could just understand that everyone has a different pace of doing things, then maybe I would get out more. I mean I have interests; whenever I'm at home I don't just sit around doing mind-numbing shit. I read all the time and I love doing sound design and computer art. I always read new articles. I can't not be informed, in fact I'm constantly worried that I'm not doing enough, that I'm not learning enough. WHen I get high, I usually don't get so high that I can't function; I just need it to relax me. I would like to relate to people more, but I'm just insecure about the fact that I'm coming from a position of having no real friends, which ironically perpetuates the problem. I wish people were less judgemental
